```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes
Headers:
  x-apikey: <YOUR_KEY>
  Content-Type: application/json
Body:
  {
    "type": "vote",
    "attributes": {
      "verdict": "malicious"
    }
  }
```

Just drop your key in place of `<YOUR_KEY>` and let me know—I'll take care of the rest!
